description: Defines classes and enums for wrapping and managing the Android vibrator hardware abstraction layer (HAL), including capabilities, reconnect logic, and specific implementations for different HAL interfaces.

classes.name: ManagerHalWrapper
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for vibrator HAL wrappers, including methods for pinging, reconnecting, and retrieving capabilities and vibrator IDs.

classes.name: LegacyManagerHalWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of ManagerHalWrapper for the legacy single Vibrator HAL.

classes.name: AidlManagerHalWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of ManagerHalWrapper for the AIDL-based Vibrator HAL, managing multiple vibrators and thread safety.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks the connectivity/status of the HAL service.

methods.name: tryReconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the HAL service after a failure or restart.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities supported by the vibrator HAL.

methods.name: getVibratorIds
methods.description: Returns a list of available vibrator IDs.

methods.name: getVibrator
methods.description: Gets a specific vibrator controller by ID.

methods.name: prepareSynced
methods.description: Prepares multiple vibrators for synchronized operation.

methods.name: triggerSynced
methods.description: Triggers synchronized vibration on multiple vibrators.
